title: Enhance rules
description: Rules in run order: each entry's fields. lib/format/format.ts enforces this in CI and in Clyde's copy, with each pattern's syntax and LIKE form; validate.ts checks what spans entries: categories, effects, samples, retired ids.

items.errorMessage: a rule: an object of its fields

id.errorMessage: up to 60 characters in one or two levels, each lowercase words of letters and digits joined by _, levels joined by a dot, not starting rul_

match.errorMessage: a description pattern, an account pattern, or both

direction.errorMessage: in for money in, out for money out, or left out for either

account_types.errorMessage: a list of at least one account type group, or left out for any account

items.errorMessage: bank, credit, investments, assets, liability, or business_payments

description.errorMessage: 1 to 200 characters: uppercase letters, digits, spaces, the symbols & ' - . + / #, and the pattern characters * ^ $ | \

account.errorMessage: 1 to 200 characters: uppercase letters, digits, spaces, the symbols & ' - . + / #, and the pattern characters * ^ $ | \

set.errorMessage: a payee, a category_id, a business_category_id, or a mix of them

payee.errorMessage: 1 to 60 characters starting with a letter or digit: letters, digits, single spaces, and the symbols & ' - / ( ) comma period +

category_id.errorMessage: a category's id: a root (personal, business, or transfers), then one or two levels, each a dot and lowercase words of letters and digits joined by _

business_category_id.errorMessage: a business category's id: business, then one or two levels, each a dot and lowercase words of letters and digits joined by _

samples.errorMessage: a list of at least one statement text
